title.narrative: Integrating Services for Maximum Impact - South Sudan (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: South Sudan, TB/HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP South Sudan)This program has the following goals: Reduction of new HIV infections by 25% by 2026 (from 2022 levels). Reduction in AIDS-related deaths by 25% by 2026 (from 2022 levels). Reduced HIV-related stigma and discrimination towards PLHIV by <10%. Increase TB detection by 40% and reduce mortality rate by 35% by 2028 compared to 2022. The objectives of this program are: Scale up combination HIV prevention to reach 70% of key, vulnerable and priority populations, and other individuals and groups at risk for HIV by 2026.. Reach 60% of all PLHIV, in all their diversity, with fully differentiated, person-centred ART services and a minimum package of complementary health and social support interventions.. Remove human rights, gender and equity-related barriers for all PLHIV and key, vulnerable and priority populations.. To increase the number of MDR/RR-TB cases notified from 176 in 2022 to at least 490 by 2028 and their treatment success rate to at least 85% by 2028.. To enhance TB prevention through i) tuberculosis preventive therapy of, at least, XX% of household contacts and XX% PLHIV starting TPT every year and ii) strengthening infection control. Promote enabling environments, in collaboration with partners and affected communities, key indicator being enhancing private provider engagement, targeting to increase proportion of notified TB cases from private providers from XX% in 2022 to YY% in 2028.. To roll out an electronic TB case-based surveillance system, lab and commodity management in all health facilities offering TB services in the country.. To improve and strengthen the governance and the programmatic management capacities for the provision of TB services at national, state and county levels.
